findings.title: protect-ffi 0.24 bump in the main Node entry ships without EQL lockstep or payload-compatibility evidence
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Lockstep comments are unchanged, but no evidence shows 0.24 changed payload format; consequence is speculative.

findings.title: Hand-set 0.18.0 plus a pending minor changeset publishes an unexpected version and drops the CHANGELOG entry
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Hand-set 0.18.0 plus pending minor changeset yields 0.19.0, which the example's ^0.18.0 specifier excludes, and no changeset documents the new subpath.

findings.title: WASM client reuses the Node API names with a different contract: it throws instead of returning a Result, and encrypts null
findings.label: valid
findings.note: WASM encrypt/decrypt return raw values/throw instead of Result objects and lack the null guard the Node entry has; divergence is introduced by this new subpath.

findings.title: Consumers using moduleResolution 'bundler' get protect-ffi's WASM typings behind stack's public types
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same as F-04: published types reference protect-ffi whose conditional exports give WASM typings to consumers without the node condition.

findings.title: CLI and wizard login depend on a new auth 0.38 native-binding layout
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Auth 0.38 moves platform bindings to optional peers and the catalog lists only six platforms as optionalDependencies, so unlisted platforms may lack a binding; plausible and caused by this change.
